verdict.rationale: HMRC has no native automation feature for users. It does run a live production REST API platform (hmrc-probe-1), and Making Tax Digital filing goes through compatible third-party software (hmrc-docs-11, hmrc-supp-3). So background automation such as quarterly submissions is possible only by building or buying external software against the API. Missing for 10: any first-party scheduling or automation feature, documentation of unattended or background operation, accessible API documentation (the developer hub blocks crawlers per hmrc-probe-2), and hands-on evidence of autonomous runs.
